parts:
My two cents: BayGeo is great to work with! That Intro to QGIS workshop we teach at maptimeDavis was something I originally developed for BayGeo many years ago. See the call for instructors below.

---

BayGeo is looking for instructors to teach geospatial workshops this Fall (late August through December). Our workshops are like short courses, typically meeting once per week for a few hours, for a few consecutive weeks. The workshops are geared toward working professionals. Topics can cover anything geospatial, and this year we're especially in need of someone to teach spatial R.

Workshops can be held virtually (Zoom) or in-person using the GIS lab at the University of San Francisco. Instructors are paid $75/hour of instruction, plus some additional paid hours for prep.

BayGeo is a non-profit organization with a mission to foster a vibrant geospatial community by facilitating knowledge sharing, networking, and professional development in the SF Bay Area and beyond!

If you're interested in teaching a workshop, contact Cam Denney at cde...@baygeo.org
